title: Cyclone separator fluid volume
prompt: In this inch Part, make the fluid volume of a cyclone separator, Z up: a collector bin 12 in across and 20 in tall below z = 0 (its top at z = 0); on it a cone from z = 0 to z = 12 in, 10 in across at the top with a 15 deg half angle; an R0.5 in fillet where the cone meets the bin's top; a 2 in diameter inlet tube along +X from x = 0 to x = 5 in, on the +Y side, tangent to the cone's side and to the plane z = 12 in (its axis at z = 11 in); an R0.125 in blend where the inlet meets the cone; and the vortex finder: a ring slot 2 in deep into the top face at z = 12 in, between diameters 2 in and 2.376 in.
